postal_system.normalization_rule: Accept a four-digit input optionally prefixed by MD and separator; preserve leading zero and canonicalize to MD-NNNN. Structural validity never proves current allocation.
postal_system.semantics_rule: The first two internal digits may identify a processing/post center and the final two an office under the reviewed quality standard; this routing structure does not create an area.
postal_system.exception_rule: Postal offices, agencies, centers, terminals, courier/transit facilities, PO boxes, routes, organizations and special/non-geographic labels remain explicit and non-areal unless separately authoritative geometry exists.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Public facility points, street/house membership, broad distribution-quality zones and administrative/locality/address/building/parcel proxies are never postcode areas.
postal_system.rights_rule: Pin provider, release/retrieval time, dataset-specific terms, attribution, schema, CRS, byte length, digest and transformation for every artifact. General portal guidance does not cure License Not Specified.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exclude recipient, customer, resident, occupant, owner, apartment, shipment, forwarding and non-public unit data.
postal_system.territory_rule: Keep Moldova identity and scope independent; do not merge neighbouring territory or alter source identity.

quality_gates.pass: Every artifact has provider, edition/retrieval time, dataset-specific terms, attribution, schema, CRS, byte length, digest and reproducible transformation.
Ordinary and exception classes reconcile against a complete current denominator; structural possibility and facility listings do not auto-create allocation.
Every feature is non-area, official area or derived area; points and membership tables stay non-area.
Postal assignment, facility, address membership, administration, building/parcel context and AGID containment remain separate.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Sources, routing classes, rights and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete rights-cleared Poșta Moldovei/ASP ordinary and exception assignment denominator, including post-office, agency, center, terminal, transit, courier, PO-box, route and special/non-geographic classes, and real postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon surfaces are pinned by edition or retrieval basis, effective date, terms, byte length, SHA-256, coverage and exceptions, published as an approved immutable artifact, and loaded through the real MD API/app so a normalized MD-NNNN search fits and renders a translucent area with a clear outline, selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. Public office points, street/house membership tables, 2015-2020 XLSX, broad distribution-quality zones, facility/route/PO-box/organization endpoints, locality/administrative/address/building/parcel proxies, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves. A derived surface is eligible only from an expressly authorized complete current postal-membership denominator with reproducible lineage, limitations and noncanonical status preserved.
Assignment, geometry, rights, privacy and independent holdout gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
